varsikasikranaatti: Felix Varsikasikra reported to S-F12 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Felix Varsikasikra is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In S-F12, Felix Varsikasikra listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Felix Varsikasikra saw Severin Heheheha freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Felix said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
Felix Varsikasikra checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

The barrage caught Felix Varsikasikra in the open at S-F12. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Felix Varsikasikra was carried in at last. Felix Varsikasikra is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F12 changed before the cheering ended. Felix Varsikasikra shouldered another load.

The man in the next bed snored all day. Felix Varsikasikra did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.
There was never a bed for Felix Varsikasikra, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F12 on his own feet.

Felix Varsikasikra traded a lock of hair in a matchbox for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A letter from home reached Felix Varsikasikra before dusk. Felix Varsikasikra read it twice and slept a little easier.
